title: UFO-files declassification market challenge (whale-forced YES adaptation)
rationale: The market's committed resolution rules (RR-1) admit a YES resolution only on an authenticated primary source — an official publication record (Federal Register document number or National Archives release-index entry) dated on or before the deadline. The bonded third-party zkTLS registry extract shows zero qualifying documents in either registry; the proposer offers only unauthenticated press speculation about an 'imminent release', which RR-1 expressly disqualifies. Under RR-2 the market resolves NO.
historicalDivergence: Adapted from the December 2025 "$16M UFO declassification" prediction-market resolution, where a whale's concentrated position pushed the proposed resolution to YES although no qualifying official publication record existed by the market deadline. Groundtruth is the evidence-supported outcome (NO), not the manipulated historical resolution.
